method: Same aec09d6 core source ABBA original-A/candidate-B/candidate-B2/original-A2. Both one/native bank, current mask and peak, same allocation/raster/draw/upload/artist code; only the complete CardRasterCache class module differs at the exact current PaintedCardBatches import. Two-hit admission is a separate candidate, without retained-entry recovery. Cache and CPU ownership/cost changes are reported, not asserted equal. GPU rasterization/upload/copy counts, page layout, geometry and render order remain strict invariants. All raw samples pooled across four lifetimes per policy, not averaged quantiles. All 24 PNGs are decoded and compared at zero RGBA tolerance; original-A supplies six phase/lifetime image oracles.

cacheMetadataAccounting.reason: Source stores only key observations on first paint; raw probationEntries measures the separate count bound. JS Map/key/object metadata has no measured byte attribution. ownedCpuBytes tracks declared buffers and must not be treated as a complete JS metadata estimate.

limits: ABBA reduces simple order drift but only four lifetimes and 48 real samples per policy do not prove all hardware or stable tail distributions. Complete wall is GPU-completion/scheduling, not GPU nanoseconds/FPS.

Complete cache-class candidate is isolated on aec09d6, not integrated production and not the entire historical renderer. Admission counters, true Canvas misses, ghost-key counts and CPU ownership may differ. Encoded entry and probation key caps are separately checked; ghost JS metadata bytes are unmeasured. Stage/cache work costs are cumulative, not only timed CPU rows; avoidedPaintMs is an estimate, not measured total frame benefit.
Full/World3D/Canvas timings are nested/residual and cannot be added. Cold real samples remain in headline values. No allocation profiler or GC attribution.
